Subject: Post-signature staged migration & activation checklist for HelioEdge

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for signing. To keep momentum, I put together an initial staged migration and activation checklist that we can embed into the MAP. High level:

- Canary window and success metrics
- Staged schema/data migration steps (non-prod → prod)
- Training schedule for ops and engineering teams
- Fallback and rollback criteria

I attached a draft HE-MAP-v1.xlsx and a short canary-schedule.pdf with proposed timeboxes. Can you confirm:

1) Which teams should we include in the training block (ops, integrations, analytics)?
2) Any blackout dates or maintenance windows in August/September we should avoid?
3) Preferred weekly cadence for canaries (daily short runs vs. weekly long run)?

I’ll loop Lauren and Marcus for the detailed rollout checklist and compliance items. Once we agree, we’ll embed these into the mutual action plan and kick off the first canary within two weeks.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

- Please include Ops (primary), Integrations, and our Data Platform (analytics can attend the overview).
- We have a companywide town hall on 2027-08-25; please avoid that week for any high-impact cutovers.
- Prefer a two-week cadence for canaries: short daily sanity for the first three days, then a 48-hour extended run at week end.

Sara — thanks, noted on teams and blackout week.

Lauren/Marcus — looping you in to finalize the MAP columns and the activation checklist. Key items we want to lock this week before we send to HelioEdge PMs:

- Canary success criteria (error rates, tail latency, business KPIs)
- Required evidence for compliance sign-off (SOC2 artifacts, minimum retention, audit log exports)
- Training plan: two sessions (Ops runbook + Integrations deep-dive), one Q/A hour; propose 2027-08-30 and 2027-09-01 (both 90-minute blocks)
- Cutover approach: staged routing using feature flags → traffic ramp (5% → 25% → 60% → 100%) over two weeks; automatic rollback on threshold breach

I attached redwood-staged-rollout-checklist.docx with a proposed task owner column. Sara — I’ll send an editable Drive link once we finalize. Marcus, can you confirm who from SRE should be on-call during canaries? Lauren, can you enumerate the compliance evidence files we can provide?

Ben

Ben / Sara —

Forwarding our compliance evidence checklist and a trimmed version of the rollout tasks below for visibility. I attached compliance-evidence-list.pdf with the items HelioEdge requested. Quick summary of evidence columns to include in the MAP:

- Artifact name (SOC 2 report, network diagrams, data retention policy)
- Owner at Redwood (security contact)
- Delivery date target
- Acceptance criteria (reviewed by HelioEdge security)

Rollout highlights (from redwood-staged-rollout-checklist.docx):
- Pre-canary: integration smoke tests, CVT pass, synthetic traffic baseline (owner: Marcus)
- Canary day 0: deploy to canary pool (5% traffic), monitor for 4 hours; if green, extend to 20% and run 48-hour extended check
- Training: Ops runbook walkthrough + integrations workshop — materials to be shared 72 hours prior
- Rollback: feature flag off + session drain; postmortem within 48 hours if threshold exceeded

Marcus — on-call list below is fine: Samira J. (SRE), Omar K. (infra lead), Priya N. (monitoring). Marcus, please confirm contacts and shift windows.

I will also export the checklist to a Google Sheet for collaborative edits — expect a link by EOD.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

A couple operational asks before we lock dates:
- Please confirm the exact list of SRE on-call names and timezone coverage.
- Can you provide the editable MAP (Google Sheet) and the final compliance artifact list by Friday 2027-08-13?
- We'll need a DocuSign link for the SOW addendum that references the MAP and the staged rollout plan.

Once we have the Sheet and SOW link we can confirm the kickoff and target the first canary for 2027-08-31.
